svg.title: northern development 2020 horizontal
svg.desc: Original source vector extraction. Source: https://www.northerndevelopment.bc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/NDIT2020AR_Final_Web.pdf; PDF page 13; crop in page points [350, 178, 510, 223]. Native PDF paths and shadings converted with Poppler pdftocairo. Gradient shadings retained as SVG linearGradient elements; no bitmap approximation.
